AcceptanceThresholds.description: Numerical scientific-validity gates compiled with a query.
AcceptanceThresholds.title: AcceptanceThresholds

AggregationStatistic.description: How a target is aggregated over its typed biological subject.
AggregationStatistic.title: AggregationStatistic

ArtifactRef.description: Content-addressed reference for arrays, images, tables, or posterior samples.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

AssayPurpose.description: Declared use of an assay inside one query.
AssayPurpose.title: AssayPurpose

AssignmentMechanism.description: How exposure was assigned to the experimental unit receiving an action.
AssignmentMechanism.title: AssignmentMechanism

BeliefStatus.description: Structural availability only; it does not assert scientific validity.
BeliefStatus.title: BeliefStatus

BeliefSubject.description: A concrete, identity-qualified biological subject of a belief or history.
BeliefSubject.title: BeliefSubject

BootstrapInterval.description:
The sampling distribution of one statistic under a declared dependence structure.

Produced by :func:`cellstate.evaluation.bootstrap.multiway_clustered_bootstrap` and carried by
the reports that state a verdict.  It lives here rather than beside the estimator because it is
a serialized boundary object, and ``domain`` may not depend on ``evaluation``.
BootstrapInterval.title: BootstrapInterval

CategoricalDomain.description: An explicit finite set of permitted categorical values.
CategoricalDomain.title: CategoricalDomain

CausalEstimandBinding.description: Typed intervention/environment contrast for one query target and horizon.
CausalEstimandBinding.title: CausalEstimandBinding

CausalStatus.description: Identification basis attached to a prediction or decision.
CausalStatus.title: CausalStatus

CellHistory.description: A frozen-top-level timeline; empty is not complete unless declared complete.
CellHistory.title: CellHistory

CellStateBelief.description: Query-conditioned posterior over the causally relevant current state.
CellStateBelief.title: CellStateBelief

CompiledStateSpecification.description: Auditable output of query compilation, embedded in every belief and forecast.
CompiledStateSpecification.title: CompiledStateSpecification

CriterionOutcome.description: Scientific pass/fail state, kept separate from calculation availability.
CriterionOutcome.title: CriterionOutcome

EvaluationStatus.description: Whether a diagnostic was calculated, separate from whether it passed.
EvaluationStatus.title: EvaluationStatus

EvidenceLink.description: An explicit, confidence-qualified link from sampled source to belief target.
EvidenceLink.title: EvidenceLink

EvidencePolicy.description: Cutoff-safe observation channels admissible for state estimation.
EvidencePolicy.title: EvidencePolicy

ExcludedStateFactor.description: A known factor intentionally excluded by query compilation.
ExcludedStateFactor.title: ExcludedStateFactor

IdentityBasis.description: Observed or explicitly inferred basis for subject identity or linkage.
IdentityBasis.title: IdentityBasis

InterventionRealizationBelief.description: Posterior over the realized intracellular effect of an intended action.
InterventionRealizationBelief.title: InterventionRealizationBelief

InterventionSchedule.description: An explicit realized or intended administration schedule.
InterventionSchedule.title: InterventionSchedule

InterventionSpec.description: A bounded action family; matching names or units alone never establishes support.
InterventionSpec.title: InterventionSpec

MatchedControl.description: Explicit linkage to the control unit used for an assigned intervention.
MatchedControl.title: MatchedControl

NuisanceBelief.description: Posterior over Xi: observation nuisance not automatically promoted to biology.
NuisanceBelief.title: NuisanceBelief

NumericDomain.description: A closed, finite numeric domain with mandatory units.
NumericDomain.title: NumericDomain

ObservationCollection.description: Biological effect of collecting one observation from its sampled source.
ObservationCollection.title: ObservationCollection

OntologyTerm.description: An extensible biological term, optionally grounded in an ontology.
OntologyTerm.title: OntologyTerm

ProvenanceRecord.description: Minimum audit trail attached to every produced belief or forecast.
ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord

QueryConstraints.description: Non-metric constraints whose violation requires abstention.
QueryConstraints.title: QueryConstraints

RealizationEvidenceRequirement.description:
Per-action evidence expected for the latent realized perturbation.

Gaps are support/readiness findings, not malformed-event errors. In particular, UNKNOWN may be
an allowed status even with a nonzero evidence minimum when observations quantify uncertainty
without identifying an efficiency.
RealizationEvidenceRequirement.title: RealizationEvidenceRequirement

ReversibilityStatus.description:
What is actually known about reversal after an intervention ends.

This is deliberately separate from a schedule's washout interval.  Removing an
exposure does not by itself establish that its biological effects are reversible.
ReversibilityStatus.title: ReversibilityStatus

ScalarRange.description: A closed finite range for values whose units are fixed by the field name.
ScalarRange.title: ScalarRange

ScheduleDomain.description: Finite support for intervention administration and washout schedules.
ScheduleDomain.title: ScheduleDomain

StateFactorSpecification.description: The dimensions of one factor that are active for a compiled query.
StateFactorSpecification.title: StateFactorSpecification

StateQuery.description: A task-specific definition of predictive and interventional sufficiency.
StateQuery.title: StateQuery

SubjectKind.description: The biological estimand represented by a belief.
SubjectKind.title: SubjectKind

SubjectSpecification.description: Query-level requirements for the concrete subject being estimated.
SubjectSpecification.title: SubjectSpecification

TargetAggregation.description: The estimand level and summary represented by a query output.
TargetAggregation.title: TargetAggregation

VersionedReference.description: Immutable identity for a protocol, model, or target transformation.
VersionedReference.title: VersionedReference
